title: Gembound
description: Gembound is a brand-new Minecraft network delivering innovative and modern gamemodes designed for an exciting player experience! Join today!
body:
# Gembound Network
Welcome to Gembound network! We are an new and upcoming modern network that focuses on community and cool gamemodes with custom features. 

We cant wait to see you ingame!👋

### 🌴 Skyblock
Start on your own floating island and expand it into a kingdom!
Grind, build, trade, complete challenges and rise on the leaderboards.
- Classic + modern skyblock
- Unique features
- Custom farming enchants
- Friendly community

### 🪓 Forest Simulator
Cut down trees in your area and earn money, gems and level!
Grind, research, upgrade, obtain pets and buffs along your way!
- Custom animations
- Unique upgrades
- Hours of fun!

### ⚒️ Resource Simulator
A one-of-a-kind tycoon-style gamemode.
Gather resources, unlock themed islands, upgrade your tools from wood to netherite, and automate with workers.
Contribute to global milestones and race to the top with the community!


### ✨ Why join Gembound?
- Multiple unique gamemodes in one hub
- Fresh progression systems & rewards
- Global leaderboards & milestones
- Friendly community & active staff
- Regular updates & events
